screens.title: Gates along the route
screens.description: A scene-based gate path previews the next destination and requires an explicit crossing action.

screens.title: Named waypoints
screens.description: Passed, current, and ahead locations communicate progress without an invented route percentage.

screens.title: Companion signal
screens.description: Brief signal choices remain previews until an explicit local send action is selected.

limitations: Original generated desert and fabric image is a broad mood study, not official Journey art or a copied scene.
The approved package boundary is the 2019 PC edition; the Steam PC release is dated 2020 and is not used here.
Sample gates, waypoints, and signals are synthetic; there is no live multiplayer or network delivery.

componentCapture.scope: Parent-reviewed component rendering; independent full-screen usage follows.
